DEVOUT-SOULFLAME.title: Soulflame
DEVOUT-SOULFLAME.description:
This card gains [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
Reduce its cost by [blue]{Energy:diff()}[/blue], but lose [blue]{HpLoss:diff()}[/blue] HP when it is played.
DEVOUT-SNUFFED.title: Snuffed
DEVOUT-HEAVY.title: Heavy
DEVOUT-GREATSLASH_ENCHANT.title: Greatslash
DEVOUT-GREATSLASH_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage.
{Angur}'s [gold]Heavy[/gold] value is increased by [blue]1[/blue].
DEVOUT-DOWNSLAM_ENCHANT.title: Downslam
DEVOUT-DOWNSLAM_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage.

If the enemy is [gold]Airbourne[/gold], [gold]Fluttering[/gold], or [gold]Soaring[/gold], it is slammed into the ground, taking [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] damage and being [gold]Stunned[/gold].

Apply [gold]Ringing[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-UPSLASH_ENCHANT.title: Upslash
DEVOUT-UPSLASH_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage.
Knock the target [gold]Airbourne[/gold] [blue]{AirbournePower:diff()}[/blue].
DEVOUT-DUAL_SLASH_ENCHANT.title: Dualslash
DEVOUT-SWIFT_SLASH_ENCHANT.title: Swiftslash
DEVOUT-SACRED_SMITE_ENCHANT.title: Sacred Smite
DEVOUT-SACRED_SMITE_ENCHANT.description: Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage, plus [blue]{Extra:diff()}[/blue] additional damage for each {PietyIcon} you have.
DEVOUT-SHADOWED_SMITE_ENCHANT.title: Shadowed Smite
DEVOUT-SHADOWED_SMITE_ENCHANT.descriptio: Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage, plus [blue]{Extra:diff()}[/blue] additional damage for each {PenanceIcon} you have.
DEVOUT-SEARING_SMITE_ENCHANT.title: Searing Smite
DEVOUT-SEARING_SMITE_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage if you have a [purple]Soulflame[/purple] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].

{Angur}'s [gold]Heavy[/gold] value is increased by the level of this enchantment ([blue]{Level}[/blue]).

This enchantment may be improved any number of times through [gold]Upgrading[/gold] its card.
DEVOUT-PARRYING_STRIKE_ENCHANT.title: Parrying Strike
DEVOUT-PARRYING_STRIKE_ENCHANT.descripti:
Gain [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain [blue]{ThornsPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] until the start of your next turn.
DEVOUT-QUAKESHOCK_ENCHANT.title: Quakeshock
DEVOUT-QUAKESHOCK_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ShockDamage:diff()}[/blue] damage and [blue]{WeakPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.

Apply [gold]Ringing[/gold] to yourself.
DEVOUT-CLEAVING_FLAMES_ENCHANT.title: Cleaving Flames
DEVOUT-CLEAVING_FLAMES_ENCHANT.descripti:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] EVERY [gold]Burn[/gold] and [purple]Soulflame[/purple] in your [gold]Draw[/gold] and [gold]Discard Piles[/gold].

Deal their damage to ALL enemies, plus [blue]1[/blue] additional damage for every [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].

If in [gold]Cliodna[/gold], increase its [gold]Strength[/gold] by [blue]{StrengthPower:diff()}[/blue] before the attack.
DEVOUT-CLEAVING_FLAMES_ENCHANT.dialogue:
Angur'kattha!
Katthaya a shyrana lashin paelash!
DEVOUT-TIDAL_SLASH_ENCHANT.title: Tidal Slash
DEVOUT-TIDAL_SLASH_ENCHANT.description:
Reduce [gold]Strength[/gold] by [blue]{CharmedPower:diff()}[/blue].

ALL enemies take [blue]{Tide:diff()}[/blue] damage for every [gold]Charmed[/gold] applied this turn.

If in [gold]Caoineag[/gold], hits [blue]four[/blue] times. Otherwise, hits [blue]twice[/blue].
DEVOUT-TIDAL_SLASH_ENCHANT.dialogue:
Angur'kattha!
Neradaya lath lashka sin drakai marah!
DEVOUT-END_OF_THE_DANCE_ENCHANT.title: End of the Dance
DEVOUT-END_OF_THE_DANCE_ENCHANT.descript:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage.
Hits ALL enemies.
{Angur} becomes [gold]Rhythmic[/gold] and [gold]Sheathes[/gold] after use.
DEVOUT-EQUINOX_ENCHANT.title: Equinox
DEVOUT-EQUINOX_ENCHANT.description:
Deal [blue]{ExtraDamage:diff()}[/blue] extra damage.
Hits ALL enemies.
{Angur}'s [gold]Heavy[/gold] value is multiplied once more for each ally that is still alive.
